changelog: BIM-Bot is in BETA: every user gets 14 days of access, and BIM-Bot shows the days left each time Revit or Navisworks starts. We need testers: report issues and ideas, and get listed on the Contributors page of our website. Need more access? Contact Hassan on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/hassan-elmathary) or at help@elmthary.space. BIM-Bot v3.0.0 — BIM-Bot Access with a live connection. Sign up once with your name and email: we email a 6-digit code, enter it and BIM-Bot unlocks. While BIM-Bot is open it confirms your access about once a minute; if access is turned off, BIM-Bot shuts down within about a minute (its windows close and the AI connection stops) and unlocks again by itself when access is turned back on. Works offline up to 7 days. Already signed up with 2.9.0? Nothing to do. Also: BIM-Bot Control Panel app; Navisworks Select by Properties and Export Viewer Package; per-user Navisworks install without admin rights.
